recorded.prompt:q-maintenance-flag:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-maintenance-flag:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-maintenance-flag:a: 'Waiting longer, sleeping in either thread, or comparing log timestamps creates no edge'; Summary: a plain write made seconds earlier can stay invisible forever.
recorded.prompt:q-maintenance-flag:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-maintenance-flag:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-maintenance-flag:b: A thread's end orders its writes only before join() on it, or isAlive() returning false (JLS callout); nothing says before every later read.
recorded.prompt:q-maintenance-flag:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-maintenance-flag:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-maintenance-flag:d: The Chain example: a plain write with no lock reaches main through a volatile edge and a join; the missing piece is an edge, not a lock.
recorded.prompt:q-routes-chain:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-routes-chain:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-routes-chain:b: Join edge runs to the return of join() on that thread; main's guarantee is explained through the chain only (weaker support: the page never says join() doesn't wait for other threads).

recorded.pass:q-routes-chain:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-routes-chain:c: 'Happens-before is also transitive...' and the worked Chain example.
